description: Defines an internal interface ISocketsTrace for socket connection tracing, extending ILogger and providing methods for logging socket connection events.

classes.name: ISocketsTrace
classes.description: An internal interface for tracing socket connection events, extending ILogger, including methods for connection lifecycle events.

methods.name: ConnectionReadFin
methods.description: Logs the event when a connection read finishes.

methods.name: ConnectionWriteFin
methods.description: Logs the event when a connection write finishes, with a specified reason.

methods.name: ConnectionError
methods.description: Logs an error related to a specific connection, including the exception.

methods.name: ConnectionReset
methods.description: Logs the reset event for a connection.

methods.name: ConnectionPause
methods.description: Logs the event when a connection is paused.

methods.name: ConnectionResume
methods.description: Logs the event when a connection is resumed.
